en-US.longDescription: IsoBuster is a highly specialized yet easy to use media data recovery tool. It supports all disc formats and all common file systems. Insert a disc, USB stick or memory card, Start up IsoBuster and select the drive or media (if not selected already) and let IsoBuster mount the media. IsoBuster immediately shows you all the partitions or tracks and sessions located on the media, combined with all file systems that are present. This way you get easy access, just like explorer, to all the files and folders per file system. Instead of being limited to one file system that the OS picks for you, you have access to "the complete picture". Access data from older sessions or hidden partitions, access data that your OS (e.g. Windows) does not see or hides from you etc.
en-US.name: IsoBuster

zh-CN.longDescription: IsoBuster 是一款功能专业且操作简便的存储介质数据恢复工具。它支持所有光盘格式及常见文件系统。只需插入光盘、U 盘或存储卡，启动 IsoBuster 并选择驱动器（若未自动选中），程序便会自动挂载介质。IsoBuster 能即时显示介质上的所有分区、轨道、会话信息，以及存在的全部文件系统。通过类似资源管理器的界面，您可以便捷访问每个文件系统中的所有文件和文件夹。不同于操作系统仅提供单一文件系统的访问权限，IsoBuster 让您掌握“完整视图”——可读取历史会话数据、隐藏分区内容，以及操作系统（如 Windows）不可见或刻意隐藏的数据信息。
